title: Alex Tracy Joins Evercore as Senior Managing Director in the Liability Management & Restructuring Group
summary: Evercore announced today that Alex Tracy has joined the firm as a senior managing director in its liability management & restructuring group. He will be based in New York.
body_markdown: Evercore announced today that Alex Tracy has joined the firm as a senior managing director in its liability management & restructuring group. He will be based in New York.
